sloka: एष शापवशादेव न वेद बलमात्मनः ।वालिसुग्रीवयोर्वैरं यदा राम समुत्थितम् ।। ७.३६.४१ ॥
transliteration: eṣa śāpavaśādeva na veda balamātmanaḥ ।vālisugrīvayorvairaṁ yadā rāma samutthitam ।। 7.36.41 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, it was due to a curse that Sugriva did not know his own strength when the enmity between Vali and Sugriva arose.
